governance: Public Ed25519 keys trusted to attest Researcher interpretation approvals and revocations (P41). The private key is derived only on the server from the existing secret P37_CATALOG_SIGNING_KEY with the domain-separation label 'mitochondria.p41.interpretation-attestation.v1|', so it cannot sign catalog snapshots. The server signs only after re-checking the decision and an active Researcher membership of the signed-in caller. Empty means no device-local approval is ever applied.
